Estimated error +/- 0.2 dB for the thin black curve and +/- 0.45 dB for the thick grey and dotted curves (the rms of the fitted polyline against the traced pixels), and +/- 0.9% in frequency (log-fit residuals on the 14 printed ticks). The figure contains three curves and all three were resolved end to end; it does not mark the tested frequencies, so the 49 vertices are the digitiser's breakpoints, reported as extracted and NOT snapped to a nominal test series -- a vertex is not guaranteed to be a tested frequency, and a tested frequency on a straight run may have no vertex.
